Class DeflateCodec

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.codec.transform.compress.CompressionStreamCodec
org.jwcarman.codec.transform.compress.DeflateCodec
All Implemented Interfaces:
Codec<byte[]>
public class DeflateCodec extends CompressionStreamCodec
Compresses with the zlib format (RFC 1950): DEFLATE data wrapped in a two-byte header and Adler-32 checksum.

Same algorithm as GzipCodec with roughly twelve bytes less framing per payload — useful for high volumes of small messages. Prefer GzipCodec when the bytes must interoperate with external gzip tooling.
